<plan>Plan Overview:
1. Approach the tree at the 3‑step south‑east location: Move East → Move South until adjacent to the tree.
2. Collect wood: Do on the tree (achievement “Collect Wood”).
3. Build a crafting table: Move to a spot adjacent to the tree and Place Table (achievement “Place Table”).
4. Craft a wood pickaxe: Make Wood Pickaxe using the table and the collected wood (achievement “Make Wood Pickaxe”).
5. Mine stone: Use the wood pickaxe to Do on stone blocks until a sufficient amount is collected (achievement “Collect Stone”).
6. Place a stone block near the table: Place Stone (achievement “Place Stone”).
7. Craft a stone pickaxe: Make Stone Pickaxe with the table, wood, and stone (achievement “Make Stone Pickaxe”).
8. Mine ore: Use the stone pickaxe to Do on iron ore blocks and coal ore blocks to collect iron and coal (achievements “Collect Iron” and “Collect Coal”).
9. Create a furnace: Place Furnace adjacent to ore blocks (achievement “Place Furnace”).
10. Smelt iron ore: The furnace automatically turns iron ore and coal into iron items (now have iron in inventory).
11. Craft an iron pickaxe: Make Iron Pickaxe with the furnace, wood, coal, and iron (achievement “Make Iron Pickaxe”).
12. Mine diamond: Use the iron pickaxe to Do on diamond ore blocks (achievement “Collect Diamond”).
13. Craft an iron sword: Make Iron Sword with the furnace, wood, coal, and iron (achievement “Make Iron Sword”).
14. Craft a stone sword: Make Stone Sword with the table, wood, and stone (achievement “Make Stone Sword”).
15. Locate and defeat enemies: Move until zombies and skeletons appear; use Do to attack them with the iron sword (achievements “Defeat Zombie” and “Defeat Skeleton”).
16. Place a plant: Place Plant adjacent to your base (achievement “Place Plant”).
17. Consume food: Do on a plant tile to eat it (achievement “Eat Plant”) and Do on a cow to eat it (achievement “Eat Cow”).
18. Find a lake: Move until a lake tile appears; Do on it to drink water (achievement “Collect Drink”).
19. Collect a sampling item: Wander until a “sampling” item appears; Do on it to collect (achievement “Collect Sampling”).
20. Manage energy: Continue moving and actions until energy drops below max; Sleep to trigger Wake Up (achievement “Wake Up”).
All blocks of the plan satisfy the 22 achievements, and the set of actions provided are sufficient for every step. The plan is linear but may require revision if terrain or enemy locations differ. This approach therefore guarantees completion of every achievement.<plan> Move East
